A '''Nightsister bloodline skull''' was a skull of a [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]]. The Nightsisters considered it a sacred artifact that honored those of the Nightsister bloodline.<ref name="SWG:Nbs">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=item|Nightsister bloodline skull}}</ref> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a group of adventurers found a Nightsister bloodline skull guarded by the [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] [[Aranei]] in the [[Rancor Cave]] on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].<ref name="SWG:TNH">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|The Nightsister Headdress|Dathomir}}</ref>
